name: xmlparser

name: xml5ever
input_api: xml5ever::driver::parse_document(RcDom, XmlParseOpts) -> XmlParser<RcDom>; TendrilSink::one(&str) -> RcDom; xml5ever::tokenizer::XmlTokenizer::feed(BufferQueue) -> token events
scope: XML5 error-recovering superset parser accepts local UTF-8 text and yields a namespace-aware DOM through its own tokenizer/tree builder with markup5ever_rcdom TreeSink; a second own tokenizer pass counts xmlns declarations omitted from DOM attributes. The two valid XML 1.0 controls yield exact expanded names, attributes, decoded text, depth and declaration counts. This does not establish strict XML 1.0 well-formedness, full namespace conformance, DTD support, or other encodings.
family: Servo xml5ever XML5 tokenizer and tree builder; shares markup5ever primitives and design lineage with html5ever, but has own XML5 parser modules; markup5ever_rcdom is only a tree sink

name: rxml
input_api: rxml::Parser::new() + rxml::Parse::parse_all(&mut &[u8], at_eof = true, FnMut(Event)) -> namespace-resolved events; rxml::RawParser::new() + parse_all -> raw attribute events
scope: Restricted XML 1.0 + Namespaces push/pull parser over local UTF-8 bytes. Default options (comments rejected). Namespace-resolved StartElement/EndElement/Text events give expanded element and attribute names, depth and decoded text; a second pass through rxml's own RawParser counts xmlns declarations that the resolver omits from AttrMap. AttrMap iterates by (namespace URI, local name), which equals document order on both controls. By design rxml has no DTD, custom entities, processing instructions or non-UTF-8 encodings and rejects comments by default, so the shared order control is rejected and an alternate second control without its comment and processing instruction is used.
family: rxml (Jonas Schäfer) own lexer, raw parser and namespace resolver, with the same-author rxml_validation crate for name and character classes; minidom 0.19 is built on rxml and is not a separate family
restricted_features: no custom entity references (only lt, amp, gt, quot, apos)
UTF-8 only; encoding declaration must be utf-8 or absent
standalone must be yes or absent
max_token_length 8192 bytes for names and attribute values by default

name: RustyXML
input_api: xml::Parser::new() + Parser::feed_str(&str), then Iterator<Item = Result<xml::Event, ParserError>>; Event::ElementStart(StartTag { name, ns, prefix, attributes: HashMap<(String, Option<String>), String> }), ElementEnd, Characters, CDATA, Comment, PI
scope: Namespace-aware SAX-like event stream over local UTF-8 text (the adapter decodes the bytes with std::str::from_utf8 and feeds the &str). RustyXML resolves element and attribute prefixes to namespace URIs, decodes predefined entity and character references, and reports CDATA, comments and processing instructions; xmlns attributes stay in StartTag.attributes and are counted as declarations. StartTag.attributes is a HashMap, so the adapter lists each element's attributes sorted by (namespace, local name), which equals document order on both controls. The README lists incomplete error checking; the valid controls do not establish strict XML 1.0 well-formedness checking, DTD handling or non-UTF-8 encodings.
family: RustyXML (crate lib name xml; unrelated to the selected xml/xml-rs crate) own state-machine parser derived from ObjFW OFXMLParser per src/parser.rs; no runtime dependencies

name: minidom
input_api: minidom::Element::from_reader(impl BufRead) -> Result<Element>; Element::name()/ns()/attrs() (rxml AttrMap keyed by namespace URI and local name), Element::prefixes.declared_prefixes(), Element::nodes() -> Node::Element/Node::Text
scope: DOM over local bytes: minidom's TreeBuilder consumes rxml RawReader events and itself resolves element and attribute prefixes, records xmlns declarations per element and builds Element/Text nodes. Expanded names, declarations, attributes and decoded text match the oracle on the catalog control and on the restricted order control. It inherits rxml's restricted XML 1.0 subset (no DTD, custom entities or processing instructions; comments rejected), so the shared order control is rejected with XmlError(RestrictedXml("comments")) and order-default-ns-restricted.xml is the second control. minidom targets the XML subset used by XMPP; AttrMap order equals document order on both controls.
family: rxml (shared with the selected rxml path): rxml lexer and RawParser via RawReader; minidom adds its own TreeBuilder prefix resolution and DOM. Not an independent tokenizer.
